response.text:
These are the deadlines and dated items for October 2026.

**Deadlines**
- Return the overdue library items (Stadtbibliothek), due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Ordnung's send-by date for this is today's date, so it is urgent. Fees keep increasing until the items are back.
- Objection to the Muster BKK contribution notice (optional), due Wed 14 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. Ordnung's send-by date is Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. An objection does not suspend payment.
- Cancel the residence permit appointment if you can't attend, due Mon 19 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78]. Ordnung's send-by date is Tue 13 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78].
- Cancel your FunkNetz Smart M mobile contract, which must arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. Post it by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. The current term ends on Sat 14 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. Check the contract terms in the letter.

**Payments**
- Parking warning fee, due Fri 2 Oct 2026: 30.00 € [item:itm_31yxpwg03cdb]. Ordnung couldn't verify this amount, so please check it against the paper letter.
- Monthly rent, due Mon 5 Oct 2026: 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7].
- Additional operating costs, due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 € [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].
- Residence permit extension fee, due Wed 14 Oct 2026: 100.00 €, paid by girocard at the appointment [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].
- Electricity advance payment, due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 €, collected by direct debit [item:itm_kttk9625293w].
- Health and care insurance contribution, due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 €, collected by direct debit [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].

**Appointments**
- Dental check-up and cleaning, Thu 8 Oct 2026 at 09:15 [item:itm_tt8cexs1k1tw].
- Residence permit extension at the Ausländerbehörde, Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. Bring all the listed original documents.

If you're unsure about the objection or the residence matter, it may be worth getting advice. You can add these dates to your calendar in Ordnung.
